facts.text: Delaware City sits at the eastern end of the Chesapeake and Delaware Canal, giving boaters a shortcut between the Delaware River and Chesapeake Bay.
The Forts Ferry Crossing, a passenger ferry, links Delaware City to Fort Delaware on Pea Patch Island.
Delaware City's historic district, along with Chelsea, the Eastern Lock of the canal, Fairview, and Fort Delaware, earned a spot on the National Register of Historic Places.
The Diamond State Base Ball Club, a non‑profit amateur organization, promotes physical fitness, educates on baseball history, and serves as a source of local pride.
Delaware City Public Library stands as the town’s central hub for books and community events, reflecting the city’s commitment to learning.
Delaware City is home to the Delaware City Oil Refinery, operated by PBF Energy, a key player in the region’s energy sector.
